decisions.reason: The button already represents navigation, so 'màn hình' is redundant; the shorter destination label preserves returning to the title screen.
A count field does not need the extra noun 'lượng'; the compact form preserves the owned-count meaning.
The owned-state label is natural and already fits the tiny/pill budget; shortening it would be stylistic only.
The quality label is natural and compact enough for a fixed setting/filter control.
The external-connection confirmation title is semantically clear and remains within the documented dialog-title budget.
The intimacy label is established, natural Vietnamese and essentially at the compact header budget.
The shorter canonical reward wording preserves the claim action while removing the unnecessary noun component 'phần'.
The race/win record is concise, natural and preserves both placeholders exactly.
The current passive sentence is substantially over-wide; the compact active warning preserves that the attempted operation is unsupported.
The close-application action is natural and already within the normal button budget.
This fixes capitalization to match the repository's canonical Support Card terminology without expanding the label.
The current Talent Bloom mechanic name is semantically complete and natural; no approved shorter mechanic form is available, so width alone does not justify changing it.
The fan-count label is clear and remains within the normal compact counter/header budget.
Distance aptitude is a gameplay mechanic; the current term is clear and established, and shortening it without an approved form could reduce mechanic precision.
The copy-here action is natural and only marginally over a normal button heuristic; shortening 'Sao chép' would be a stylistic terminology change.
The skip-confirmation title is concise, natural and well within the dialog-title budget.
Repository-approved cramped-UI 'Uma' replaces the over-wide full name while preserving the not-owned status and demonstrative.
Reviewed race UI already uses compact 'đua'; dropping 'Cuộc' preserves the story-race category and brings the label within budget.
The full training term fits this compact control; the project's shorter 'Tập' form is context-dependent and is not needed here.
The base-stat label is natural, mechanically clear and already within the compact header budget.
